title: AISHA Plugin Manifest
description: Manifest contract for plugins assimilated by AISHA. Defines identity, capabilities, lifecycle, sandbox policy and dependency resolution.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does.

kind.description: Plugin kind — determines load strategy, runtime behaviour AND the materialization target: every kind maps to a materialize_* function that turns an approved manifest into a resolver-visible registry row (agent→agent_catalog, backend_provider→ai_provider_registry, automation_node→custom_node_registry, auth_provider→auth_provider_registry, web_tracking→web_tracking_registry, data_source→agent_knowledge_sources; full_stack composes). 'agent' is a marketplace agent (declarative run-as-story or executable call-mode). 'data_source' is an ingest connector loaded by the source-broker plugin host (IDataSource), NOT the compute sandbox — and NOT backend_provider, which is LLM-shaped.

trust_tier.description: Trust level — internal: full trust, partner: verified, external: sandboxed.

capabilities.description: Granted capability URIs (e.g. rpc.get_partner_stats, http.GET./metrics, cron.daily_rollup).

config_schema.description: JSON Schema (object) konfigurace pluginu pro tenanta. Čtou ho DB funkce activate_data_source, get_data_source_secret_status a set_data_source_secrets: `required` a `properties.*.secret` (pověření). Tvar sjednocen s manifesty a konzumenty 2026-09-16.

secret.description: Pověření — ukládá se přes set_data_source_secrets, nikdy do konfigurace.

web_entry.description: Relative path to web module entry (e.g. web/index.ts).

backend_entry.description: Relative path to backend module entry (e.g. backend/index.ts).

n8n_entry.description: Relative path to n8n node entry (e.g. n8n/node.ts).

migrations_dir.description: Relative path to SQL migrations directory.

load_strategy.description: Load strategy hint. Runtime may override based on kind (auth/backend = always cold).

lifecycle.description: Entry points for each module type.

rpc_allowlist.description: RPC functions the plugin may call from the sandbox. The broker reads them from the APPROVED sandbox policy (get_plugin_sandbox_policy); empty = no writes.

agent_spec.description: Run-as-story template — present only for kind='agent' declarative agents. Consumed by install_agent_as_story to mint a consumer-owned story.

rule_slugs.description: Published expert_rule slugs composed into the installed story's ruleset.

knowledge_items.description: Knowledge items hydrated under the new (consumer-owned) story_id.

dependencies.description: PŘÍMÉ npm závislosti zdroje pluginu (balík → verze). scripts/plugins/build.mjs je porovná s tím, co bundler skutečně zabalil; nesoulad je chyba buildu.

provider_spec.description: kind=backend_provider materialization contract → ai_provider_registry (read by materialize_backend_provider). Secrets stay in env: auth_env_var is a NAME.

auth_env_var.description: Env var NAME holding the credential — never the value.

global.description: true = base/global row visible to every instance; default scopes to the approving instance.

node_spec.description: kind=automation_node materialization contract → custom_node_registry (read by materialize_automation_node). deployed_to_n8n stays with the provision pipeline.

auth_spec.description: kind=auth_provider materialization contract → auth_provider_registry (read by materialize_auth_provider). Lands DISABLED — an IdP is an inbound trust boundary; the operator enables. client_secret_env_var is a NAME.

client_secret_env_var.description: Env var NAME holding the client secret — never the value.

config.description: Non-secret protocol config (scopes, claim mappings, button hints under config.button).

tracking_spec.description: kind=web_tracking materialization contract → web_tracking_registry (read by materialize_web_tracking). Lands DISABLED (privacy boundary); loading is additionally consent-gated per visitor via consent_category.

source_spec.description: kind=data_source materialization contract → agent_knowledge_sources (read by materialize_data_source). Lands is_active=false BY CONSTRUCTION: activation requires the instance's 4D classification (Source Onboarding Contract) — the plugin declares WHAT it can read, the instance classifies and binds credentials. WHERE the adapter runs is declared by `host`: `sandbox` (default) = a connector packaged by scripts/plugins/build.mjs and run by the plugin-exec shim; `source-broker` = an IDataSource module svc-source-broker's plugin host imports in-process from its image (not packaged, not sandboxed).

adapter_entry.description: Module path. host=sandbox: the build packages it into a sandbox artifact. host=source-broker: the build only checks it exists; the broker image carries the compiled module (SourceAdapterModule) and loads it via SOURCE_ADAPTER_PLUGIN_ENTRY.

host.description: Where the adapter runs. `source-broker` opts an in-process IDataSource out of sandbox packaging — it may use what the sandbox disables (e.g. a native pg client). Unknown values are an error, never a silent sandbox. Resolved by scripts/plugins/host.mjs.

default_config.description: Declared defaults (poll cadence, plausibility bounds). NEVER credentials and NEVER the 4D classification — those are instance data.
